Small-batch coffee, roasted on the pier.

We roast twice a week in a converted boathouse and deliver within forty miles. This paragraph is long enough to select, and it rewraps when the window narrows.

This week's roasts

Lighthouse

Washed Ethiopian. Bergamot, apricot, black tea.

Low Tide

Colombian decaf. Cocoa, brown sugar, orange.

Fog Bank

House espresso. Hazelnut, molasses, cherry.

Driftwood

Sumatra. Cedar, dark chocolate, earth.

Breakwater

Kenya AA. Blackcurrant, grapefruit, cane.

Riptide

Natural Brazil. Peanut brittle, raisin.
